title: Model comparison benchmark runner and CSV reporting tool
description: Implement training/benchmark_models.py to evaluate trained or candidate CNN models against held-out test splits, measuring accuracy, precision, recall, F1, model size (MB), and CPU inference latency (ms/image), outputting results to reports/model_comparison.csv (PRD 4A & 11).
acceptanceCriteria: Loads held-out test datasets or mock evaluation sets with open/closed labels
Evaluates candidate architectures: Custom Compact CNN, MobileNetV2, EfficientNetB0, ResNet50, Depthwise CNN
Generates confusion matrices and classification reports
Writes measured metrics to reports/model_comparison.csv without hardcoding fake metrics (PRD 4A)
Unit tests verify benchmark calculations and report formatting

steps.details: Implement CLI script taking --data-dir and --models-dir, iterating through candidate models.
Use scikit-learn metrics to compute accuracy, precision, recall (prioritizing closed recall), F1-score, and confusion matrix.
Measure per-image inference latency across 100 warm-up and timed runs on CPU, calculating mean and standard deviation.

steps.description: Write output to CSV and test with dummy models
steps.details: Create tests/test_benchmark.py evaluating two small test models and verifying CSV columns in reports/model_comparison.csv.

technicalNotes: Adhere to PRD 4A: never report placeholder metrics as measured values.
Support graceful skipping with documented reason if heavy models (e.g. ResNet50) exceed RAM.
